hypothesis: When the trailing seven-day funding differential among five major Binance USD-M perpetuals is at least 25 basis points, the lowest-funding contract outperforms the highest-funding contract over the following seven days strongly enough for an equal-notional long-low/short-high spread to retain positive price expectancy after actual funding, taker fees, and modeled slippage.

provenance.reason: Alpha #9 failed its preregistered carry mechanism because funding did not exceed fees and slippage, but its already-observed development result contained positive residual price PnL. Alpha #13 tests that price-reversal interpretation only on observations not available when this file was registered.

research_basis.source: Chi, Hao, Hu and Ran (2023), An empirical investigation on risk factors in cryptocurrency futures
research_basis.relevance: Cross-sectional futures basis is reported as a stronger short-horizon predictor than momentum, but the paper uses dated OKEx quarterly futures and a wider universe; it motivates testing, not assuming transfer to Binance perpetuals.

research_basis.source: Cao, Luo, Cheng and Dong (2026), Anatomy of Cryptocurrency Perpetual Futures Returns
research_basis.relevance: A recent perpetual-futures study reports that log basis and a price-volume factor explain many candidate predictors; this makes basis/crowding attribution and strict fresh-data validation necessary.
Publisher-checksummed USD-M 1h trade-price and mark-price archives are the required forward price source; monthly funding archives reconcile provisional REST funding rows.

fresh_sample.rule: No observation with a timestamp at or before registered_at_utc can contribute PnL or count toward a gate.
fresh_sample.first_eligible_decision_reason: The first Monday decision for which the complete seven-day signal lookback is later than preregistration.

fixed_signal_and_execution.score: sum of actual funding events with timestamp in (decision - 7 days, decision]
fixed_signal_and_execution.long: lowest score, alphabetical symbol as exact-tie breaker
fixed_signal_and_execution.short: highest score, alphabetical symbol as exact-tie breaker
fixed_signal_and_execution.entry: next 1h candle open at Monday 05:00 UTC
fixed_signal_and_execution.exit: Monday 05:00 UTC after seven days, unless an individual 10% adverse stop is reached first
fixed_signal_and_execution.panic_override: No discretionary override; the fixed 10% per-leg stop and portfolio gates are the preregistered protection.

cost_and_accounting.funding: actual event rate times contemporaneous mark-price notional; long pays positive funding and short receives it
cost_and_accounting.mark_to_market_frequency: each completed 1h candle using adverse exit slippage and exit fee

development_gate.monthly_target_interpretation: This may qualify only as a portfolio sleeve. Live promotion still requires the combined locked-forward portfolio to meet the platform's 10% geometric monthly target and all risk gates.

data_integrity.trade_price: Binance USD-M daily 1h kline archives plus publisher CHECKSUM
data_integrity.mark_price: Binance USD-M daily 1h markPriceKlines archives plus publisher CHECKSUM
data_integrity.funding_provisional: Binance public /fapi/v1/fundingRate response sealed after each complete UTC day
data_integrity.funding_final: Binance USD-M monthly fundingRate archive plus publisher CHECKSUM
data_integrity.forward_report_source_binding: Every evaluated UTC day is bound by its day-manifest SHA-256; the ordered day/manifest inventory and current protocol digest are recomputed from sealed sources whenever report currency is assessed.
data_integrity.future_information: Signals use funding timestamps at or before 04:00 UTC; execution and PnL begin at the following 05:00 UTC open.

prohibited: using Alpha #9's already-seen development or locked interval as Alpha #13 confirmation
moving the 25bp threshold, seven-day lookback, Monday decision, one-hour execution delay, holding period, stop, costs, sizing, or universe after forward collection begins
dropping a losing symbol or leg after observing it
calling equal notional exactly beta neutral
crediting favorable funding when raw relative price PnL is non-positive
opening locked validation before every development gate passes
raising leverage or notional to manufacture the monthly return target
placing real orders before the platform-wide live preflight passes
